                  JOHN C. AND SHERRI L. MARTIN’S INITIAL BRIEF

       John C. and Sherri L. Martin, Intervenors, address Preliminary Order Issue No. 8,
“Weighing the factors set forth in PURA § 37.056(c) and P.U.C. Subst. R. § 25.101(b)(3)(B),
which proposed transmission-line route is the best alternative?”
       Link G41 adversely impacts the Martins. The Martins oppose any route using link G41.
       Applicants propose 122 routes, and identified route 894 as best meeting the applicable
routing factors. Appls. Exhs. 1 (at Att. 11), 5 (at pp. 10-16), & 13 (at pp. 3-5). Route 894 does
not include link G41. The Martins do not oppose its approval.
       Commission Staff recommends approval of route 487. Staff Exh. 1 (at passim). That
route does not include link G41. The Martins do not oppose its approval.
       Some intervenors prefer other routes which garnered enough discussion in testimony to be
part of the focus of attention. Those are reflected in Appls. Exh. 22, the “Routes of Interest”
Map. Those routes of interest do not include link G41. The Martins do not oppose their approval.
       Thus, the Martins request that the approved route not include link G41. Approval of any
of the “routes of interest,” including Applicants’ best meets route 894 and Staff’s recommended
route 487, would be consistent with the Martins’ request not to use link G41.

                                             Respectfully submitted,
